notes.elevation: trail gain_m/loss_m: segments are oriented along the trail's walking order, 20 m DEM profiles concatenated and 2 m hysteresis applied once per chain (new chain piece at gaps > 50 m; pieces summed). climb_total_m = gain_m + loss_m, direction-free. Agency-only segments contribute to trail totals.
notes.island_total: island_total_m counts every included segment, including agency-only segments whose geometry is not redistributable (kept in data/canonical/private/, gitignored). island_total_shippable_m counts only segments whose geometry ships in segments.geojson.
